title: Siman 422
section: Fleeing from Philosophical Inquiry and Strengthening in Faith

segments.he: לוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ, כִּי יֵשׁ אֵצֶל הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ כַּמָּה חִדּוּשִׁים וְקַבָּלַת מָמוֹן שֶׁלּוֹ הוּא חִדּוּשׁ אֵצֶל הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ בֵּין הַחִדּוּשִׁים שֶׁלּוֹ:
segments.en: (16.) He answered and said: "Do you not know that in Germany the books of the holy Zohar are not to be found? And even though the holy Zohar books were printed there — even so they are not available there. They were sold to our land. And because the books of the holy Zohar are not there — they therefore go dressed in German garments. For garments are the aspect of the encompassing lights. And because of this one must be very careful to maintain the garments in cleanliness and to press them..."
